logos.name: Company logo (griffin + wordmark)
logos.treatment: Background removed; alpha mask recolored via CSS (maroon in light mode, cream in dark mode)

logos.name: V shield (avatar)
logos.treatment: Alpha mask; replaces full logo in frames 260px tall or less

logos.name: Bravo! Winner badge
logos.treatment: Cropped to circle, 240px; shown beside totals in frames over 420px tall

primaryMetric.label: Team members honored since 1999
primaryMetric.value: Distinct people in the roster, de-duplicated by hashed employee number, or by name where no number exists (1,815)

content.list: Every award as its own row, grouped by quarter, newest first (Q4 2025 back to 1999); rendered in batches on scroll
content.search: Name search, as-you-type (120 ms debounce), case- and accent-insensitive, multi-word AND match, matched text underlined; Escape clears

personalHonoree.trigger: hash(employeeid or employeeCode) matches one or more roster rows
personalHonoree.label: Congratulations, {roster name}
personalHonoree.detail: {n} Bravo! award(s): up to 3 quarters, then 'and N more'
personalHonoree.behavior: Own rows highlighted and starred; 'Show mine' filters to the viewer's awards; compact frames show the name only

content.emptyState: No honorees match "{query}". Check the spelling or try just a first or last name.
content.privacy: Employee numbers never displayed; stored only as FNV-1a 32-bit hashes for matching

data.identityNote: Not location-scoped; same roster for every location.
data.dataSource: Static, embedded from Quarterly_Bravo_Recognition_Program.pdf (same cleaned roster as Bravo! Winners widget)

matching.accepted: Digits with optional leading zeros or a short letter prefix (61854, 0061854, TM61854, TM-61854)
matching.ignored: Unresolved tokens like {{employeeId}}, non-numeric IDs (e.g. UUIDs), unknown numbers -> standard view
matching.result: Matched name shown as 'Congratulations, {name}' with award count and quarters

display.layoutTiers: Over 420px tall: badge shown; 330px or less: totals hidden; 260px or less: shield replaces logo, count hidden, personal strip compacts
